Rumour: **The Sky-Sent.** "They fell from the sky; the sky protects them"
Deed: End two rounds of one battle in the open (no cover) and not be downed
Legend: **Sky-sent** ("the Sky-Sent"): when you take a crushing consequence, you may spend your reaction to read it as solid

Deed: Be on your feet at the end of a battle in which two allies within 3 inches of you went down
Legend: **Bad omen** ("the Jinx"): enemies in contact with you cannot Assist each other

Deed: Before a roll of your own, call its exact total, and hit it
Legend: **Foresight** ("the Seer"): before you Ask the voice, call "good" or "bad"; if you are right, you are also **Hyped**

Rumour: **The Gate-Captain.** "The one who nearly reached the gate"

Deed: Come home carrying an item you did not start the battle with
Legend: **Light fingers** ("the Debtor"): picking up an item costs you no action

Rumour: **The Star.** "I know that face from the pictures"
Deed: Win a melee exchange with three or more other fighters, friend or foe, within 6 inches
Legend: **Crowd-pleaser** ("the Star"): when you win an exchange, one ally within 6 inches is **Hyped**
